name: capiva-cloud
description: Capiva Cloud — plataforma que democratiza o acesso e o deploy em Kubernetes.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "bun run --cwd backend dev" "bun run --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck && bun run --cwd cli typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd cli test && bun run --cwd frontend test && bun run --cwd mobile test
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd backend lint && bun run --cwd frontend lint && bun run --cwd mobile lint
scripts.format: bun run --cwd backend format && bun run --cwd frontend format && bun run --cwd mobile format
scripts.format:check: bun run --cwd backend format:check && bun run --cwd frontend format:check && bun run --cwd mobile format:check
